clayresearch.message: Cross-domain synthesis narrows typed adaptive recurrence, current 4B+vision candidate evaluation, and one-binary/nonambient-effect authority into differential tests; preserve OPEN until H1/Ubuntu evidence.

gwt.message: Bind LoopDynamicsReadout/RecurrenceDecision to WorkspaceEpisode traces and test whether ignition/focus adds value beyond delta+pressure+utility baselines; no scalar emergence shortcut.

emergenz.message: Dynamic regime classification and recurrence are not emergence evidence; use the controller as an intervention surface for lesion/rescue, re-entry, interaction and OOD-transfer tests.

claycode.message: BASE priority remains WP-02 production frontend. Existing language must express loop readout/decision, deterministic receipt hashes, PROPOSAL_ONLY authority and later feature/version state; redesign only on demonstrated expressibility failure.

hyperposition.message: Test bounded alternative reopening only after typed stall detection against no-reopen and random-reopen under matched cost/stability.

claygraph.message: Use Frank V7 persistent ClayGraph as regression/diagnostic evidence. H1 may export graph views; H3 must test equivalent transient derived topology without assuming a separate persistent graph DB.

unifieddb.message: Persist/replay loop readouts, decisions, interventions, outcomes and adaptive-vision feature/classifier lineage; physical placement remains evidence-gated.

harness.message: loop_dynamics_reference.py plus an 8-test unit oracle is committed. Component evidence only, not H1 PASS. Integrate after state-ledger epoch/causal-parent binding and run fixed-depth/delta-only/typed-controller replay.

frank.message: Evaluate Qwen3.5-4B as current official Qwen-class 4B candidate; compare native vision features with a cheap frozen MVC backbone and compare three nonambient effect-boundary realizations.

common_invariants: model output is not execution authority
low state delta plus high residual pressure is not convergence
one deployable binary does not automatically imply one authority domain
synthetic and local component results do not promote live/Ubuntu claims
